subject: reasoning
question: Ravi starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 5 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Ravi starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards south.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 5 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P
